{{Top|leg}}
A '''Free Agent''' was a position within [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Reporting directly to either the head of the [[Operations (Alliance Intelligence)/Legends|Operations]] department or the [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]], a Free Agent required a special dispensation from [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. They were virtually identical in scope to solo [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operatives]].
